_comment: Standalone stereo calibration for the Sony ILX-LR1 pair, in the cameras/rigs schema of modules/cameras.json.
DATA-ONLY: not loaded by modules/camera_registry.py; nothing consumes it until it is merged into cameras.json.
Calibration groups 7/8 follow on from the VOYIS eyes (5/6).

ilx_left._provenance: Checkerboard solve 2026-09-30 from Stereo_Calibration/dive_001 (pool, 2026-05-18): 60 of 61 detected boards used, reprojection RMS 1.15 px. Focal FIXED at the stated 16 mm (fx=fy=2016.8 px, assuming the 3000 px image height spans the 23.8 mm sensor height); a free-focal solve gave fx=1985+/-49 px at the same RMS. Principal point 1-sigma +/-14/15 px. UNVALIDATED as a RealityScan prior.
ilx_left._distortion_comment: OpenCV radial coefficients (k3 and tangential held at 0). NOT converted to RealityScan's coefficient convention.

ilx_right._provenance: Checkerboard solve 2026-09-30 from Stereo_Calibration/dive_001 (pool, 2026-05-18): 59 of 59 detected boards used, reprojection RMS 1.40 px. Focal FIXED at the stated 16 mm (fx=fy=2016.8 px, assuming the 3000 px image height spans the 23.8 mm sensor height); a free-focal solve gave fx=1995+/-54 px at the same RMS. Principal point 1-sigma +/-19/20 px. UNVALIDATED as a RealityScan prior.
ilx_right._distortion_comment: OpenCV radial coefficients (k3 and tangential held at 0). NOT converted to RealityScan's coefficient convention.

ilx_lr1_stereo._focal_comment: 16 mm per camera as stated by the operator 2026-09-30. The calibration images carry no EXIF. The onr2b survey EXIF (same lens model, FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G) reads 24 mm (DSC* body) and 29 mm (_CA3* body, serial 01001083) - a different zoom setting, so this calibration does not apply to onr2b.
ilx_lr1_stereo._stereo_baseline_comment: SUPPLIED, not measured here: 225.425 mm from docs/rs-reference/13 section 3.5, confirmed by the operator. The checkerboard square size is unknown, so the solve is in square units (|T|=19.38 squares) and this baseline sets the scale; implied square 11.63 mm.

extrinsics_left_to_right._convention: OpenCV: X_right = R * X_left + T, camera frames x right, y down, z forward, T in metres.

quality._comment: The eyes are not hardware-synchronised; pairs are left/right frames within 60 ms of each other of a handheld laminated-paper board with glare. Treat the relative rotation and the off-axis translation components as approximate.
